source.interpretation: AUTOM requires a matched bidirectional policy on its support link. Deleting the parent policy's second ONDEM row leaves the station disconnected from h9 through the h36 horizon while retaining a valid profile link; whether pending demands and failed items remain unresolved is determined from native evidence.

Keep the h0-9 first row, matched PFRMS/PTOMS, AUTOM station, stock, failure/repair, missions, seed and collection identical. Require exact 22-populated-table authored roundtrip.
Converter must report zero errors and produce nonempty valid SXO, event log and JSON report. Explain warnings, and do not infer success from process exit status alone.

Verify the same first fault near h9.8829, h10 system demand/backorder and physical depot spare reservation. For the no-reconnection claim, there must be no physical spare or failed-item transport start/arrival from h9 through h36. Distinguish a queued or reserved item from an item in transit. Examine whether native future task times use a horizon sentinel.

Trace the system repair task, later mission orders and outcomes, 72 half-hour SystemResults and StockTotalResults bins, ResultSummary, terminal readiness/backorder and physical stock at both stations. Reconcile the persisted unmet demand and failed item state against the accepted h11-reconnection parent, which restored readiness h11.3333 and depot stock h12. Classify any conversion rejection or missing report as a diagnostic, not a positive behavior case.

Use guarded session-0 SSH under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, preserve active GUI PID 13340 in every hidden native step, seal raw artifacts, and require a separate independent read-only reviewer replay without importing the author checker.
limits: One no-reconnection period to h36, one initial demand, one seed and one support link. No claim about a finite later reconnection, local opening stock, repeated demands, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity.
